confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of an insider threat (user_04) transitioning from reading files within their department to accessing and downloading sensitive files across multiple unauthorized departments (Legal, Marketing, Logs) over several days.

attack_chain.description: User_04 begins accessing files outside of normal working hours (17:38) within their own department (finance).
User_04 expands scope by accessing files in the Legal department, which is outside their normal directory baseline.
User_04 begins downloading files from the Marketing department, indicating a transition from reading to data exfiltration.
User_04 downloads files from the Logs directory, further demonstrating unauthorized cross-departmental data collection.
User_04 completes a pattern of downloading sensitive files from the Marketing department.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_04 was granted temporary elevated permissions or had a valid ticket for these cross-departmental accesses.
No information on the destination of the downloaded files to confirm external exfiltration.
narrative: User_04, a junior accountant, exhibited a progressive pattern of unauthorized behavior starting with off-hours access to finance files, followed by accessing and downloading sensitive documents from the Legal, Marketing, and Logs departments. This pattern of cross-departmental data collection and the transition from reading to downloading strongly indicates an insider threat incident.
